title: Video-First Content Strategy: Why Video Gets Found

facts.fact: According to the page, 91% of businesses now use video as a marketing tool (the page does not name a source for this figure).
According to the page, 67% of marketers who have not yet adopted video plan to start using it in 2026 (the page cites wyzowl.com for this figure).
According to the page, 90% of video marketers use YouTube to reach their audiences (third-party figure, no source named in the page text).
According to the page, 87% of respondents confirm that video directly increases sales (the page cites vidico.com for this figure).
According to HubSpot as cited on the page, adding a video to a landing page can increase conversion rates by up to 86% (third-party claim).
facts.quote: adding a video to a landing page can increase conversion rates by up to 86%

facts.fact: The article is dated February 14, 2025, and written by WSI Digital Communications Manager Cecilia Decima.
